description: AbstractGraphActor.java defines an abstract class for an Akka actor whose behavior is driven by an Akka stream graph. It manages message mapping, stream source queue, exception handling, and logging, serving as a base for stream-based actors in the project.

classes.name: AbstractGraphActor
classes.description: An abstract Akka actor class that uses an Akka stream graph to define its behavior, handling message processing, stream source queue, exception handling, and logging.

methods.name: mapMessage
methods.description: Abstract method to convert incoming messages of type M to type T.

methods.name: beforeProcessMessage
methods.description: Hook to modify messages before processing; default implementation returns the message unchanged.

methods.name: createSink
methods.description: Abstract method to provide the Sink for the stream.

methods.name: getBufferSize
methods.description: Abstract method to specify the buffer size for the source queue.

methods.name: createReceive
methods.description: Defines the actor's message handling, setting up stream source queue and message matchers.

methods.name: getSupervisionStrategyAttribute
methods.description: Creates supervision strategy attributes for stream error handling, resuming on exceptions.

methods.name: getSourceQueue
methods.description: Initializes and returns the stream source queue with logging and supervision.

methods.name: incrementDequeueCounter
methods.description: Increments the dequeue counter each time an element is dequeued.

methods.name: preEnhancement
methods.description: Hook for subclasses to add custom message matchers before default ones.

methods.name: handleDittoRuntimeException
methods.description: Handles DittoRuntimeException by sending it back to the sender.

methods.name: handleMatched
methods.description: Processes matched messages, logs details, and offers them to the source queue.

methods.name: incrementEnqueueCounters
methods.description: Updates counters based on the result of offering messages to the queue.

methods.name: handleUnknownThrowable
methods.description: Handles unexpected throwables by logging and sending an internal error message.
